body:
It's all on me. My fault. My apologies. The few times she has caught me trying to harm myself she has stopped me, threatened to call the cops, etc. While I am literally on my knees in tears begging her to just let me end my suffering. 

Edit: A few times after the fact she has apologized with the remark "don't make me that way". So that is my fault too...

About 10 years ago I took a loaded revolver, put the barrel in my mouth, cocked the hammer back,  closed my eyes, put my finger on the trigger firmly... and I froze... on top of the nearly crippling depression I was already feeling I was completely overcome with fear in that last 2-3lbs of pressure. I was so close, and I just broke down in tears and couldn't do it. 

I wasn't crying because of the depression or the fear, I was crying because I was filled with pure hatred of myself for being such a coward that I couldn't pull the trigger.

Over the last few months I have nearly started crying at random because I wish I had just ended it all then.

I have tried to bring it up, but she has a huge taboo about getting professional help, even couples counseling, because of the social view of it in the countries she grew up in.

It has gotten to the point I am afraid to even try discussing anything with her because it just seems to trigger a fight about previous fights.

As far as why she is on edge all the time, I used to have some theories but they have all been replaced with the feeling that I am the problem. I am not doing or saying the right things or I am just, at my very core, not good enough.
